# APPENDIX D MEETING ROOMS AND BULLETIN BOARDS (cont.)

## 2 ) Mount Zion

Bulletin boards for exclusive use of CNA are located in the basement near the dining rooms, near the OR on the 4th floor.

### 5. UC LOS ANGELES

## (a) Meeting Rooms

Meeting can be scheduled in rooms in areas adjacent to the in-patient areas in accordance with local campus procedures. Nurses who are nurses at the UCLA Medical center may have access to certain lounges in patient care areas in accordance with local campus procedures. The following are rooms available in accordance with local procedures and access routes:
